messages:
Maya L.: Quick ask 1: can someone assemble a onepage solution brief aimed at enterprise buyers: focus areas = security controls (VPC, KMS/HSM, audit logs), SLA tiers across deploy modes, a compact bench snapshot, and a clear inbound routing spec for leads. Need copy and routing rules by EOD Tue.

Tom R.: I like to own copy. Will do hero + 4 bullets + footer with webinar CTA. Need bench numbers and a tiny decision flow.

Sanjay K.: I can provide benches and an ops note about variability for onprem. Raw numbers (today):

Sanjay K.: ```benchmarks
hosted-gptq-13b: p50=95ms, p95=260ms, est $/kTokens=7.5
dedicated-13b-4bit: p50=38ms, p95=90ms, est $/kTokens=4.2
private-vpc (typical customer): p50=30-150ms, note: network egress and storage can add tail
```

Priya M.: Messaging: open with outcome "Enterprise-ready inference: compliant, cost-conscious, and predictable." Subhead: "Hosted for speed, Dedicated for predictability, Private for compliance." Add CTA: "Schedule a security & SLA review." Also propose webinar title: "Deploy Modes Decoded: Security, SLAs, and Cost for Enterprise Inference" (45min).

Maya L.: Nice. For the lead form routing: propose these rules for HubSpot:
- If "company_revenue" > 500M OR "employee_count" > 2000 -> route to AE-Enterprise.
- If "compliance_needs" includes any of [HIPAA, FedRAMP, PCI] -> route to SE-Security.
- If "deployment_interest" == "Private" AND "urgent=true" -> auto-schedule SE call (30m).
- Otherwise -> SDR + autoresponder with onepage attached.

Tom R.: Also include a checkbox "Require onprem or airgapped deployment" (helps SRE triage). If checked, add tag "airgap-eval" on contact.

DesignBot: Layout suggestion: 2column hero + sidecallout. Callouts: "Security" (icons for VPC, KMS/HSM), "SLAs & latency" (p50/p95), "Cost snapshot" (perk token estimates). Small decision flow: three boxes -> Hosted / Dedicated / Private with 1line why.

OpsBot: Tiny legal/compliance note to include: "Customers may require additional contractual terms for data residency and encryption-in-use; consult Sales before POC."

Sanjay K.: One more bench note: please round p95 to nearest 10 for the brief. Also add a tiny footnote: "Benchmarks measured on Redwood fleets with typical 2sec prompt; your workload may vary."

Priya M.: Suggested two short anonymized quotes:
- "Redwood cut inference cost per active request by 35% while improving median latency" - Anonymous fintech CISO
- "We met internal data residency requirements without re-architecting our stack" - Anonymous healthtech platform lead

Maya L.: Action list: Tom draft Wed AM, DesignBot to drop Figma layout Wed noon, Priya finalize quotes and webinar blurb Wed PM, Sanjay publishes final bench numbers Wed AM, OpsBot to provide legal footer language Wed EOD, I'll assemble and publish Thu AM and schedule webinar invite for next Tue.

Tom R.: Drafting now. Will share a short copy-only doc in the channel when ready.

DesignBot: Figma placeholder: https://figma.com/file/abc/enterprise-inference-brief (will update assets).

Maya L.: Perfect. If anyone sees blockers ping me. :rocket:
